ai_summary: Customers find it difficult to locate important payment information but acknowledge that FlowPay eases payment tracking.
ai_recommended_action: Improve the UI and navigation to make important payment information more accessible and prominently displayed.
evidence: Important payment information is difficult to find. | FlowPay makes payment tracking much easier.

ai_summary: Customers request the ability to export invoices in various formats (Excel, PDF, CSV) and support for bulk downloads to improve accounting efficiency.
ai_recommended_action: Develop and release features to allow invoice export in Excel, PDF, and CSV formats with bulk download capabilities.
evidence: Please add an option to export invoices to Excel. | We need bulk invoice downloads for accounting. | Invoice export would save our finance team several hours.

ai_summary: Many customers report the mobile app is slow and unstable, including freezing during transaction history scrolling, unexpected sign-outs, and general sluggishness.
ai_recommended_action: Investigate and optimize the mobile app's performance and stability focusing on scrolling, session management, and overall speed improvements.
evidence: Transaction history freezes when I scroll. | The app keeps signing me out. | The latest version feels slower than the previous one. | The mobile application has become very slow.

ai_summary: Users experience severe issues with payments failing post-OTP entry, double charges, app crashes during payments, login failures, missing OTP codes, slow checkouts, and deducted amounts without order confirmation.
ai_recommended_action: Initiate an urgent investigation into payment processing and authentication workflows; fix bugs causing transaction failures, duplicate charges, login and OTP delivery issues immediately.
evidence: My payment failed after I entered the OTP. | I was charged twice for the same transaction. | Checkout keeps loading and the payment never completes. | The amount was deducted but the order was not confirmed.

ai_summary: Customers report long delays in receiving refunds, unclear refund status, and lack of visibility into refund processing timelines.
ai_recommended_action: Enhance refund processing reliability and provide clear, real-time refund status updates to customers to reduce uncertainty and delays.
evidence: Support confirmed a refund but I have not received it. | My refund has not arrived after ten days. | The refund status has been pending for a week.

ai_summary: Mixed feedback on dashboard usability: some find it clean and helpful, others report confusing navigation, slow loading, and desire for customizable dashboard widgets and clearer analytic filters.
ai_recommended_action: Improve dashboard navigation, speed up loading times, and add options for widget customization and clearer filter controls for analytics.
evidence: The analytics screen needs clearer filters. | Please allow us to customize dashboard widgets. | The dashboard takes too long to load. | The new dashboard is clean and helpful. | The dashboard navigation is confusing.

ai_summary: Customers express satisfaction with the prompt resolution of their problems by customer support.
ai_recommended_action: Continue maintaining strong customer support responsiveness and possibly highlight support successes in communications.
evidence: Customer support resolved my problem quickly.

ai_summary: Customers seek integrations with accounting software, CRM platforms, and APIs to simplify workflows and support transaction reconciliation.
ai_recommended_action: Prioritize development of integrations with popular accounting software, CRM systems, and provide robust API support for transaction reconciliation.
evidence: Please add an integration with our accounting software. | We would like API support for transaction reconciliation. | Please connect FlowPay with more CRM platforms.
